call_inputs.Name: TRAINING ONLY - Unit selection and response
call_inputs.Nature: Fictional Academy site-inspection exercise for Department 51. No emergency, patient, or external notification delivery claim.
call_inputs.Note: Software training only. Use this incident to practice selecting a call and recording response updates.
call_inputs.Address: Fictional Academy exercise site, Chicago, IL
call_inputs.Contact Info: Training coordination point: west exercise entrance.

replay_steps: Sign in normally and select the intended unit using Settings > Active Unit. Verify the current unit and crew before proceeding.
In Calls use the lower-right plus control. Review Name, Nature, Priority and Type.
Enter the supplied training location manually. This recipe does not perform lookup, geocoding, route or live-GPS verification.
Select only the agreed training recipient, Confirm the picker, review the final form and Create.
Locate the returned incident in the active list and verify its generated number and title. The recorded title search returned no results; do not teach that search as successful.
Open the new incident and use Set Active. In Select Status choose Responding, verify the new call under Calls, review an optional note and Submit.
Return to Calls and verify the unit identity, saved Responding state and selected incident together.
Use the On Scene status action for this software exercise, verify the same call destination, add the simulation note and Submit.
Open the incident Activity view and verify both saved entries and notes. A readable tab-entry screenshot is still needed.
Use incident actions > Close Call. Review Closed, the completion note and notification choice before saving.
Verify the exercise has left the active main list. Check the sidebar separately; the recording still shows the selected call there after closure.

Use Deselect only for the intended exercise and review the normal confirmation. The native confirmation was observed through browser accessibility, but the tool cannot capture its pixels. Final selection/status verification remains pending.
